title: Doxygen commands
summary: `@brief`, `@param` and `@return` show as written, not as parts of the card yet
prose:
A parameter's description could sit beside that parameter in the card, and
the return description beside the return type; today the whole comment shows
as text, commands included.

value.wrong: @brief, @param and @return show as written instead of beside the return type and each parameter

hover.markdown:
### function `area`

---
→ `int`
Parameters:
- `int width`
- `int height`

@brief Computes the area of a rectangle.
@param width The horizontal extent.
@param height The vertical extent.
@return The product of both sides.

---
```cpp
int area(int width, int height)
```
